subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Day!
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our Annual Employee Appreciation Day is just around the corner! This year, we have planned a fun-filled day with team-building activities, delicious food, and exciting prizes. We can't wait to celebrate all your hard work and dedication. Please mark your calendars for next Friday, and stay tuned for more details coming your way soon. Let's make this year's event the best one yet! Best regards, The HR Team
